title: Run the weekly audit
purpose: The week's hours, pay, and payments are checked before anything is paid or invoiced. Month end still pays and invoices at month end, on the weeks this checklist has signed.
with: the Portfolio Managers for the daily reports, Youssef Medhat for the flags, Moharam for the partner facts
when: Once a week, on Thursday, after the 4:00 PM count.
needs: The company report for the week
The daily reports, one per site per day
The verdicts from the quality dashboard
The wearer log for the week
The expense claims with their receipts

steps.do: Check the week's accepted hours per site
steps.detail: Take each site's number for the week from the company report and set it beside that site's daily reports. The phone's own count of recorded minutes is a third number to check against.
steps.check: Every site has one number for the week, and you can explain any difference.

steps.do: Take every flagged session out of the week's hours
steps.detail: The verdicts come from Youssef Medhat's dashboard. A flagged hour is never paid and never invoiced. A disputed flag goes to Youssef Medhat, not to you.
steps.check: No flagged session is in any total.

steps.do: Match the wearer log to the accounts
steps.detail: Every session has a named wearer. Every wearer has an account in their own name and a consent form in the folder.
steps.check: Every paid session has a name, an account, and a consent form.

steps.do: Check each partner statement against its sites
steps.who: You, with Moharam for the facts
steps.detail: A partner's hours are the accepted hours its sites delivered, with the flags out. A day with no daily report is held. A partner with an open phone count is held.
steps.check: Every partner line rests on daily reports and verdicts.

steps.do: Check the pay lines for operators and site leads
steps.detail: Accepted hours, minus the handbook penalties, plus referral and performance rewards. Each line rests on the wearer log, the verdicts, and the offer letter.
steps.check: Every pay line has a record: who, what, which hours.

steps.do: Check every expense refund against its receipt
steps.detail: No receipt, no refund. The name, the date, and the amount on the claim match the receipt.
steps.check: Every refund on the list has a receipt attached.

steps.do: Write every difference down with a name
steps.detail: Who owes the answer and by when. A difference with no name is not closed.
steps.check: Every difference has a name and a date.

steps.do: Sign the checklist and file it
steps.detail: Send the open differences to Moharam for the sites and partners, and to Youssef Medhat for the flags. Month end pays and invoices on a month of signed checklists and Youssef Medhat's second pass.
steps.check: The signed checklist is in the month's folder.

done: The week's hours, pay lines, and payments are checked. Flagged sessions are out. Every difference has a name, and the checklist is signed. Nothing is paid or invoiced this week: that happens at month end.

fails.if: The company report and the daily reports do not agree for a site
fails.then: Write the difference with the Portfolio Manager's name. A site still open on Monday goes to Moharam, who holds the books.

fails.if: A site has a day with no daily report
fails.then: A partner is not paid for that day. For our own sites, Mano chased it at 6:15 PM. Ask him for the answer.

fails.if: A session has no name in the wearer log
fails.then: It is not paid to anyone. Send it to the Portfolio Manager, copy Youssef Medhat.
Moharam checks the facts, you handle the money, the Commercial Director handles the contract, all the same day. Adham approves any change of terms. The payment waits while any phone count is open.

fails.if: Someone asks you to pass a line without a record
fails.then: No. Say no once and tell Adham the same day.
Finish on Friday before anything else. Month end does not pay on an unsigned week.

escalate: Adham, the same day, for any pressure on the money. Youssef Medhat for a disputed flag. Moharam for a site or partner that does not answer.
